{"credits": [{"type": "finder", "user": {"avatar_url": "https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/15832659?v=4", "events_url": "https://api.github.com/users/Pig-Tail/events{/privacy}", "followers_url": "https://api.github.com/users/Pig-Tail/followers", "following_url": "https://api.github.com/users/Pig-Tail/following{/other_user}", "gists_url": "https://api.github.com/users/Pig-Tail/gists{/gist_id}", "gravatar_id": "", "html_url": "https://github.com/Pig-Tail", "id": 15832659, "login": "Pig-Tail", "node_id": "MDQ6VXNlcjE1ODMyNjU5", "organizations_url": "https://api.github.com/users/Pig-Tail/orgs", "received_events_url": "https://api.github.com/users/Pig-Tail/received_events", "repos_url": "https://api.github.com/users/Pig-Tail/repos", "site_admin": false, "starred_url": "https://api.github.com/users/Pig-Tail/starred{/owner}{/repo}", "subscriptions_url": "https://api.github.com/users/Pig-Tail/subscriptions", "type": "User", "url": "https://api.github.com/users/Pig-Tail", "user_view_type": "public"}}], "cve_id": "CVE-2026-76087", "cvss": {"score": 8.2, "vector_string": "CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:H/A:N"}, "cvss_severities": {"cvss_v3": {"score": 8.2, "vector_string": "CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:H/A:N"}, "cvss_v4": {"score": 0.0, "vector_string": null}}, "cwes": [{"cwe_id": "CWE-639", "name": "Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key"}, {"cwe_id": "CWE-862", "name": "Missing Authorization"}], "description": "### Impact

The anonymous front-end action `formie/submissions/submit` (`SubmissionsController::actionSubmit`) trusted a client-supplied `submissionId` when loading an incomplete submission, with no session binding, ownership check, or edit token validation.

An unauthenticated attacker could enumerate sequential submission IDs and overwrite or hijack another user's in-progress (multi-page / save-for-later) submission. Tampered data could be persisted and forwarded via notifications and integrations when the submission was completed.

Completed submissions were not affected (`isIncomplete=true` filter). This is an incomplete remediation of [GHSA-pgxq-p76c-x9cg](https://github.com/advisories?query=GHSA-pgxq-p76c-x9cg), which added edit-token validation to `save-submission` but not to `submit`.

### Patches

Fixed in **3.1.31** (Craft 5) and **2.2.23** (Craft 4).

When resuming an existing submission on a site request, the submission ID must match the session-bound submission (`Form::getCurrentSubmission()`) or a valid `submissionEditToken` when `editingSubmission` is set. Cross-form submission ID reuse is also rejected.

### Workarounds

No reliable workaround without upgrading. Disabling multi-page forms or save-for-later reduces exposure but does not remove the vulnerability.
